structure_summary.general: LocalLossMLP with instantiate_last_block = False: (num_fc_layers - 2) local-loss blocks, then an output stack trained by ordinary backprop. Inputs are 14x14 = 196 features; outputs are 16 wide (10 classes, zero-padded labels). Activation x^2 + x everywhere; no biases.
structure_summary.local_block: forward linear (in -> width, propagate_backward = False, so no gradient goes below the block) followed by x^2 + x; local head = one linear width -> 16 (propagate_backward = True into the block). The block's activation is the next stage's input.
structure_summary.local_loss: per block, the head's output is compared with the one-hot label; the delta is (head output - label) per sample (the same squared-error form as the main loss, no 1/2, no mean), back-propagated through the head and the block's forward linear. Each block is updated from its own loss only.
structure_summary.output_stack: linear (previous width -> last hidden width, propagate_backward = False) + x^2 + x + linear (-> 16, propagate_backward = True into the stack's first linear); trained by the main loss on the model output.
structure_summary.between_blocks: activations flow forward; no gradient flows between blocks or from the output stack into the blocks (the first linear of every block and of the output stack has propagate_backward = False). Losses are not summed: within one step every layer is updated by its own optimizer from its own loss, all with the same lr. Backward order: output stack first, then the blocks from last to first.
structure_summary.test_time: the model output (output stack), not the local heads
structure_summary.packing_RE_CE: in the encrypted model, row packing (RE) and column packing (CE) alternate along the chain starting with RE for the first block's forward linear, as the paper's RE/CE labels describe; the plaintext twin has no packing
structure_summary.eMLP2: block(196 -> 64, head 64 -> 16) then output stack (64 -> 32 -> 16); paper Table 3: RE(64) -> CE(32)
structure_summary.eMLP3: block(196 -> 128, head 128 -> 16), block(128 -> 64, head 64 -> 16), then output stack (64 -> 32 -> 16); paper Table 3: RE(128) -> CE(64) -> RE(32)
structure_summary.weight_decay: 0 for every layer in the full setting (precision_analysis.py sets both decay knobs to 0)
structure_summary.indices_vs_emlp1: different from eMLP-1's for the same seed: the per-epoch shuffle uses the global RNG after model construction, and eMLP-2/3 draw a different number of initial weights
structure_summary.source: read from ReBoot's model and block code for understanding, and from the built models' attributes (structure field); no ReBoot code is reproduced
